report.summary: The investigation identified a critical issue in the orders service, primarily driven by connection pool exhaustion and misconfiguration. The error rate in the orders service spiked to 6.91% (ALR-001), significantly above the threshold, and logs indicated repeated failures when calling the payments service (LOG-00557, LOG-00579, LOG-00580, LOG-00583, LOG-00595, LOG-00607, LOG-00609). The dependency relationship between orders and payments (DEP-004) further supports this hypothesis. Additionally, the orders service exhibited elevated database pool utilization, peaking at 39.9% (MET-00155), which aligns with resource constraints. While the payments service showed HTTP 500 errors (LOG-00667, LOG-00684, LOG-00686), there was no evidence of timeout issues or certificate expiry.
